HideScenePaddingBorder.Name: Hide Scene Padding Border
HideScenePaddingBorder.Hint: Hide the black scene and canvas outlines for everyone in this world. Saving a change reloads connected clients.

StatusIconHeight.Name: Status Icon Height (%)
StatusIconHeight.Hint: Set each status icon's height as a percentage of its displayed token artwork. Try 4% for a modest increase, or 0% for Foundry's default sizing.

BrowserFavicon.Name: Browser Favicon
BrowserFavicon.Hint: Choose an image for the browser tab after signing in. Leave blank to use Foundry's usual icon.

BrowserTitle.Name: Browser Tab Title
BrowserTitle.Hint: Set the browser tab title after signing in. Leave blank to use Foundry's usual title.

TopAlignChatPortraits.Name: Top-Align Chat Portraits
TopAlignChatPortraits.Hint: Show the upper part of tall artwork in Character Chat Selector's sender portraits. Each player still chooses whether to show portraits.

CompactChatPortraits.Name: Compact Chat Portraits
CompactChatPortraits.Hint: Place the sender name beside the portrait in Character Chat Selector messages.

ResourcePanel.Drag: Drag to move the HP & MP panel

Show.Name: Show HP & MP Panel on Token Selection
Show.Hint: Automatically show the Project FU resource panel when you select a token you can edit.

ResourcePanel.NoTokens: Select a token to adjust its resources.
ResourcePanel.InvalidAmount: Enter a positive whole number or leave the amount blank to use 1.
ResourcePanel.Defeat: Set HP to zero. Shift-click to toggle defeated status. Right-click to change HP only.
ResourcePanel.Heal: Restore full HP. Right-click to change HP only.
